formula.pick_now_score: this_week_wp - 0.45*save_score + 0.10*(this_week_wp - future_avg_wp); high this-week WP + low unique future value → pick now
formula.win_rate: wins_in_week / n_sims (bye / missing game counts as non-win)

notes.schedule: PLACEHOLDER round-robin (272 games). Prefer nfl_dp_schedules in DB mode.
notes.strengths: Calibrated demo EPA-style priors with contender-tier bumps (KC/BUF/PHI/SF/DET/BAL...).
notes.rosters: Mixed: named demo skill cores for 5 teams; generic depth for others. Absolute usage shares + usage_role taxonomy (QB1/RB1/WR1…).
notes.cal_usage: Absolute target/rush shares with residual 'other' bucket (floor=0.08) — prevents sparse-roster inflation. v1.3: usage_roles taxonomy + SCRIPT_USAGE_MATRIX + personnel mix.
notes.cal_survivor: v1.4: team W/L season paths → week win rates + inspectable save_score / pick_now_score (see survivor.py FORMULA_NOTES).
notes.cal_sources: Recent NFL season shapes (2022–2024) + alignment with nfl_handicapping_framework HFA/stdev and box-score EFFICIENCY_CV≈0.22. No fabricated player grades; DB baselines used when present.
notes.survivor_mode: team_wl_paths (Layers 1–2 + injury strength shocks; Layers 3–4 skipped for speed)
